rows: Foreign income taxed only if brought to Malta
Residents who are not domiciled in Malta pay tax on foreign income only when it is remitted to Malta; foreign capital gains stay untaxed even when remitted.
Minimum annual tax of €5,000 applies when foreign income is €35,000 or more.
Special tax status for non-EU nationals who buy or rent qualifying property in Malta.
Property purchase from €275,000 (€220,000 in Gozo and the south) or rent from €9,600 a year (€8,750); health insurance; no EU/EEA/Swiss nationals.
